dataGrid.description: Virtualized spreadsheet-style data grid with inline editing, range selection, search, copy and paste, resizing, sorting, and pinned columns.
dataGrid.moveAndEdit: Click or use arrow keys to move. Press Enter, F2, or start typing to edit the focused cell.
dataGrid.rangeControls: Hold Shift to extend a range. Copy, paste, delete, search, pin, sort, and resize with familiar spreadsheet controls.
dataGrid.tableDescription: TanStack table instance returned by useDataGrid.
dataGrid.heightDescription: Maximum scroll viewport height in pixels.
dataGrid.directionDescription: Reading direction used for keyboard movement and pinned columns.
dataGrid.stretchColumnsDescription: Lets non-selection columns grow to fill available width.
dataGrid.columnsDescription: Column definitions and cell editor metadata.
dataGrid.dataChangeDescription: Receives edits, clears, pastes, and row updates.
dataGrid.rowAddDescription: Adds a row and may return the cell that should receive focus.
dataGrid.readOnlyDescription: Keeps navigation, sorting, and selection while disabling edits.
dataGrid.rowHeightDescription: Controls virtual row height and line clamping.
dataGrid.initialStateDescription: Initial sorting, sizing, visibility, and pinning state.
dataGrid.cellVariantDescription: Chooses the display and editor behavior for a column.
dataGrid.optionsDescription: Options used by select and multi-select cells. Each option accepts the Badge color palette through color.
dataGrid.columnReadOnlyDescription: Disables editing for this column only.
